phases.name: Ramp in
phases.note: Stop every set with 3 reps left. Week 1 is 2 sets, 3 sets from week 2.

phases.name: Build
phases.note: Stop 1 to 3 reps short of failure. Add reps or weight every session you can.

phases.name: Deload
phases.note: Half the sets, same weights. Keep the daily physio work.

phases.name: Build, harder
phases.note: Priority exercises (marked) get a 4th set: chest, shoulders and arms. Isolation work can go to failure.

phases.name: Deload and retest
phases.note: Half sets in the first two sessions. Retest in the last session: max push ups, goblet squat reps, single arm row reps.

warmup: Band shoulder exercise 2 sets, shoulder blade and chin back
Standing row 2.5 kg, 1 x 10 with 6 sec hold
Band hip abduction, 3 steps each side x 2
Table top leg extensions, 1 set to fatigue
Ramp up set: 1 easy set at half the working weight

exercises.name: Goblet squat
exercises.cue: Toes out, 3 sec lowering, ribs down, pelvis tucked.

exercises.name: One arm DB row
exercises.cue: Shoulder blade back, chin tucked, elbow to back pocket, 1 sec squeeze.

exercises.name: DB floor press, neutral grip
exercises.cue: Shoulder blades back and down.

exercises.name: DB Romanian deadlift
exercises.cue: Soft knees, hips back, flat back, finish with glutes.

exercises.name: Band pull apart
exercises.cue: Arms straight, thumbs up, 2 sec hold.

exercises.name: Lateral raise (superset)
exercises.cue: Light, lead with elbows, stop at shoulder height. Straight into hammer curls.

exercises.name: Hammer curl (superset)
exercises.cue: Palms facing, elbows still, shoulder blades back.

exercises.name: Table top leg extension
exercises.cue: To fatigue. Stop when the back arches.

exercises.name: Half kneeling 1 arm DB press

exercises.name: Band lat pulldown

exercises.name: Single leg glute bridge

exercises.name: Lateral raise
